display_name: K. V. Sarma & C. T. Rajagopal
one_line: Kerala mathematics scholars who recovered and translated the works of the Kerala school of astronomy and calculus in the 20th century.

appearance.age_look: late 50s to early 60s, scholarly, lean-medium build
appearance.face: Oval faces with medium-brown South Indian complexions; Sarma with gently arched brows, thin lips and a calm, focused gaze; Rajagopal with slightly broader nose, softer jawline and a thoughtful, analytical look; default expression serious but kind, eyes bright with curiosity.
appearance.hair: Both with short, neatly combed black hair lightly streaked with grey; Sarma’s hair parted to the left, slightly receding; Rajagopal’s parted to the right and fuller at the sides; no headwear.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-20th-century South Indian scholar attire: both wear plain, long-sleeved, buttoned cotton shirts in off-white tucked into simple handloom dhotis in soft beige, dhotis wrapped to ankle length with a narrow darker beige border; Sarma has a light grey woven cotton shawl neatly draped over his left shoulder and across the chest, while Rajagopal has a thinner pale blue khadi shawl folded over his right forearm; both wear modest brown leather sandals; subtle details like a simple steel wristwatch on Sarma’s left wrist and a thin black fountain pen clipped in Rajagopal’s shirt pocket; textiles look matte and slightly textured, with very minimal patterning on the dhoti borders only.
appearance.signature: A worn, dark-brown leather satchel carried by Sarma with visible stuffed papers and a rolled manuscript peeking out, while Rajagopal holds an open hardbound notebook covered in handwritten mathematics and tiny Sanskrit phrases, both props treated together as their single shared signature of manuscript-based scholarship.

ref_desc: K. V. Sarma and C. T. Rajagopal are lean, medium-brown, late-middle-aged scholars with short greying black hair, off-white shirts, beige dhotis, grey and pale blue shawls, carrying a worn dark-brown manuscript satchel and an open notebook in a muted off-white, beige, grey, blue palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two dignified South Indian male scholars in late-middle age standing side by side: both with medium-brown complexions, lean-medium builds and oval faces; Sarma has gently arched brows, thin lips and a calm, focused gaze, short neatly combed black hair lightly streaked with grey parted to the left and slightly receding, wearing a long-sleeved buttoned cotton shirt in off-white tucked into a soft beige ankle-length dhoti with a narrow darker beige border, and a light grey woven cotton shawl draped over his left shoulder across his chest, modest brown leather sandals, a simple steel wristwatch on his left wrist, and carrying a worn dark-brown leather satchel with papers and a rolled manuscript peeking out. Rajagopal has a slightly broader nose, softer jawline and thoughtful analytical eyes, with short black hair lightly greying and parted to the right, wearing the same off-white shirt and beige dhoti with narrow darker beige border, a thinner pale blue khadi shawl folded neatly over his right forearm, modest brown leather sandals, a thin black fountain pen clipped in his shirt pocket, and holding an open hardbound notebook filled with visible but unreadable mathematical scribbles and tiny Sanskrit-like strokes. Keep the overall palette in off-white, beige, light grey, pale blue and dark brown, emphasize clean mid-20th-century South Indian scholar clothing, and show them front-facing in neutral standing poses so their faces, hair, garments and shared manuscript-satchel-and-notebook signature are clearly visible head to toe.
